ns2:course.label: Nineteenth Century Philosophy
ns2:course.description: Examination of the thought of such major figures as Hegel, Marx, and Nietzsche. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One course in philosophy.
